Eli: follow-up: we need clearer metric normalization when benching across hw. right now we average tokens/s and mix hw types and it's noisy.
Zoey: Agreed. Suggest adding normalized tokens/s = tokens/s * hw_perf_factor where hw_perf_factor is semi-empirical baseline per hw class.
Raj: how to compute hw_perf_factor? baseline job that runs a canonical small model and records stable tokens/s per hw class. store that number and use it for normalization.
Eli: also annotate bench artifacts with raw and normalized metrics. that helps rollout comparisons.
Zoey: edge case: quantized models on t4 may have better cost-normalized throughput than fp16 on a100 for small seqs. normalization should be optional - used only for cross-hw trend analysis.
OnboardBot: NOTE: bench artifact schema update required: add fields: raw_throughput, normalized_throughput, baseline_hw_id, normalization_method.
Raj: action items: Zoey will create baseline runner, Eli will update dashboards to show both raw and normalized metrics, I'll update eval pipeline to ingest normalization tags.
Eli: timeline: 1 sprint for baseline job + dashboards. good to get this in before next release cycle.
Zoey: :thumbsup:
Raj: :rocket:
